clues.value: Episode 14: “The Tooth Shall Set You Free”

clues.label: Episode synopsis
clues.value: ▇▇▇ has a serious toothache, but hates the thought of having anything done about it.  The doctors suspect prejudice when an inordinate number of black casualties are brought in from a single unit, led by ▇▇▇ Weems.
